adaptation: Anthropic quarterly review adapted explicitly to three calendar months after the local research date. This is an internal research management date, not an issuer event, falsification deadline, sale/holding deadline or prediction. New saved evidence can trigger earlier review. No automatic next date is generated.
author_quote: Review theses at least quarterly, even when nothing dramatic has happened
basis_quote: 次回の内部研究管理日は2027-01-16（Asia/Tokyo）とする。
